summary_bullets: Add PHASE2_RELAUNCH_COUNT for grouped phase-2 reuse-copy fall-through relaunches
Include phase-2 relaunches with phase-3 Claude fallbacks in the existing cost-threshold warning and fallback counter file total
Cover the warning path in the dispatch waterfall harness and document the combined threshold semantics
commit_message:
Count phase-2 waterfall relaunches in fallback warning

Track grouped phase-2 reuse-copy fall-through relaunches separately from phase-3 Claude fallback count, and include both counters in the existing cost fallback threshold and persisted fallback total.

Update the dispatch waterfall regression harness and related docs for the new PHASE2_RELAUNCH_COUNT stdout key.
